front.note: The circular door now has a continuous metal rim and fitted gasket; the two straight horizontal gasket chords are gone. The control strip and cabinet silhouette remain intact.

rear.note: The plain rear panel, rounded cabinet corners and continuous lower edge remain intact. No new geometry protrudes through the back or sides.

detail.note: The enlarged door shows a smooth round glass edge, a continuous fine gasket on the rim and a rounded dial; the existing small right-side latch remains seated.

underside.note: The low view shows the circular door projection seated against the cabinet without crossing trim or loose gasket lines. The cabinet bottom remains closed.

clay.note: The untextured view retains clear concentric door layers and clean rounded case edges; no floating straight gasket geometry remains above or below the door.

front.note: The visible firewood now reads as rounded logs across the grate beneath the authored flame cluster. The recessed firebox, brick lining and door frame remain separated and legible.

rear.note: The rear casing seam, flue collars, short supporting legs and base plate retain their original arrangement, with no repaired wood protruding through the shell.

detail.note: The exposed lower log sections have fuller rounded bodies and restrained taper instead of the previous angular branch tips. Flames and brick courses remain unobstructed; upper flames partly obscure the wood.

underside.note: The low angle retains the base, supporting legs and grate structure with the firewood contained inside the firebox. No detached bark strands extend beneath the stove.

clay.note: The clay view keeps the recessed masonry, layered metal frame and distinct log stack readable. The flame silhouettes and stove outline remain unchanged by the wood repair.

front.note: The stowed rubber hose now forms a continuous rounded bend from the front guide to its retained end position, replacing the earlier sharp polygonal corners. The shell and hub covers remain intact.

rear.note: The fixing plate and rear case retain their shape with no visible protruding repair geometry. The rear connector is largely occluded here; its retained endpoints are covered by the measured geometry tests.

detail.note: The case, side cover and front guide remain closely fitted in the enlarged view. The visible hose entry is smooth and seated in the guide; the lower bend lies outside this crop.

underside.note: The low view clearly shows the stowed hose sweeping smoothly beneath the guide, without a pinched inner corner or detached endpoint. The nozzle holder and bottom casing remain separate.

clay.note: The neutral clay view confirms a rounded continuous hose silhouette and the retained casing, cover and mounting-plate construction, without the former hard angular bends.
